name: Full Tilt / independent-second-boost-nonmechanologist
notes: Printed Full Tilt red is a Mechanologist attack action with cost2, power5, and exactly Boost. CR8.3.9 makes banishing the top deck card optional additional cost; banishing a Mechanologist grants this attack go again, while other top cards do not. Empty deck prevents paying Boost but does not prevent ordinary play. Dash young has only an optional start-game item setup ability, and no item is started in these main-phase fixtures. No Hyper Driver, Teklo Pounder, High Octane, equipment or other boost modifiers exist. First card boosts by banishing zero_to_sixty_blue, attacks for5, and earnsAP1. Play second plain Boost card zero_to_fifty_blue for0 and boost again this turn; top remaining Raging Onslaught red is Generic, so it is banished but second attack gains no go again. Second power1, final opponent14, AP0, empty deck, two exact banished identities. First card's gained go again must not leak to second; Boost is not once per turn. Payment-order correction from independent review: the Boost modal declares the optional cost early (CR5.1.3b). With positive resource cost, accepting before pitching leaves original Deck intact/Banish0, AP1/resources0 and priority1. Pay resource/AP asset costs first (CR5.1.7-8), then actually banish the top card as the effect-cost (CR5.1.9), before opponent priority. The two action checkpoints detect eager banishing before pitch, but same-action post-payment outcomes alone do not establish internal AP-before-banish ordering; a paired shared-path witness must cover that internal order.
